item.title: Operation BBQ Relief
item.description: DeSoto County Assistant District Attorney and Lafayette County Circuit Court judge candidate Steven Jubera was at Walmart over the weekend, volunteering his barbquing skills at the Operation BBQ Relief tent. The organization is a charity that feeds people barbecue during disasters. He is pictured with one of the many Operation BBQ volunteers.
